hardware: Bosch MED17.x gasoline direct injection ECU

flash_memory_map.full_flash: 2MB typical (calibration + OS in flash, adaptations in EEPROM)
flash_memory_map.cal_region: Often 0x10000+ for maps, verify with your dump

checksum.description: Multiple CRC32 regions (poly 0xEDB88320) over map blocks + OS. Correction values patched at end of regions. Public algorithms in tuning community (similar to WinOLS MED17 plugin). Always verify corrected bin with original CS before flash. Shared multipoint path with EDC family in checksum.rs for 2MB bins.
reference_files: public example bins from personal dumps only
checksum.routine: Rust multipoint_crc fully operational for MED17/EDC in v0.8.0

security_access.reference: security.rs + common public seed/key tables for MED17 (level 1 diagnostic, level 2 extended, level 3 flash/programming)
levels: Level 1: OBD diagnostics / DTC / live data

maps_and_xdf.description: Community addresses or TunerPro/WinOLS to define: Ignition timing (main/spark advance), Fuel (lambda/VE), Boost (wastegate/target), VVT, Knock control. Auto-load uses refined start addresses; expand with personal verified dumps.

notes: Fully operational in v0.8.0. MED17 is very common in modern VW group cars. Protocol: full UDS via CAN in Rust (iso_tp + kwp extensions). Security access uses public known algorithms. Checksum: multipoint CRC similar to EDC16. **For personal use only - always bench read your own ECU first, never flash unverified bins.** Use with cheap OBDLink or J2534 interface. Industry-leading free path.
